session_id.Description: A session identifier of the form ses-<label>, matching a session found in the dataset. There MUST be exactly one row for each session. Values in session_id MUST be unique.

original_session_id.Description: Label of the session assigned by the scanning institution (non-BIDS format)

acq_time.Description: Acquisition time refers to when the first data point of the first run was acquired.

scanning_institution.Description: Name of the institution where the participant was scanned

manufacturer.Description: Name of the manufacturer of the MRI scanner

scanner_model.Description: Model name of the MRI scanner

field_strength.Description: Magnetic field strength of the MRI scanner
